## About
Vince's Auto Service is a family-owned repair shop on E Colorado Blvd in Pasadena, run by owner Vince Egan. It's a complete service and repair facility that handles factory-recommended maintenance and repair, from minor cosmetic work to major mechanical jobs.
The shop specializes in foreign cars like Audi, BMW, Infiniti, Jaguar, Lexus, Mercedes, Nissan, Range Rover and Toyota. Brakes are a big part of the work here, along with engine, electrical, transmission and body repair.
Customers on Google rate the shop 4.7 from 57 reviews. One reviewer wrote that her family has been bringing their cars here since before she could drive.

## Services
- Brake service: Brake pad replacement, rotor resurfacing or replacement, brake fluid flushes and full brake system inspections covering pads, rotors, calipers, hoses and fluid.
- Foreign car repair: Car repairs on many makes and models, especially foreign ones.
- Faulty air conditioner or engine that won't start: Whether your air conditioner is faulty or your engine won't start, bring it in.
- Transmission service: Diagnosing and repairing transmission problems.
- Cosmetic and mechanical repairs: Minor cosmetic repairs up to major mechanical services.

## FAQ
Q: Can you pick up my car?
A: Yes. The shop offers local pickup and drop-off. Give them a call and they'll take your car off your hands.

Q: Can I get a car while mine is in the shop?
A: Yes. You can rent a car from the shop if you need a way to get around while your vehicle is being worked on.

Q: When are you open?
A: Six days a week. Call ahead or just drive on down to the shop.
